fusions.name: Sprung Barb
fusions.desc: Springs a barbed polyp at a wounded target up to 6 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Bursting Pool
fusions.desc: Spits a pool of reef water that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. Each target is left [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Pool
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, 1% more for every 1% cast speed you have. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
